messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates are for the entire country; some provinces have additional regional holidays):

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** (Monday) | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | — |
| **February 20** (Monday) | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | — |
| **March 20** (Monday) | Good Friday | — |
| **March 23** (Thursday) | Easter Monday (Newfoundland & Labrador) | — |
| **April 7** (Monday) | Victoria Day | — |
| **May 22** (Monday) | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia) | — |
| **June 19** (Monday) | St. John’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | — |
| **July 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** (Monday) | Civic Holiday (Ontario) | — |
| **September 18** (Monday) | Labour Day | — |
| **October 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving (Canada) | — |
| **November 10** (Monday) | Remembrance Day (observed) | — |
| **December 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | — |
| **December 26** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day | — |

These dates give you the standard federal holidays that create long weekends across Canada. Some provinces also observe additional holidays (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Newfoundland & Labrador, **Heritage Day** in British Columbia, etc.) that could add extra days off. If you need province‑specific lists or want to pull this data programmatically, let me know!
